decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list of 25 products to identify items that are actual backpacks rather than camping accessories or apparel. My consideration set includes a variety of specialized carry solutions: a baseball bag, a tactical rucksack, a hydration pack, a cooler backpack, and a premium technical winter pack. I ultimately selected the Mubasel Gear Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_132) because its exceptionally high review count (over 10,000) and strong 4.6-star rating provide the most confidence in its quality and value compared to the other more specialized or lower-reviewed options.
